name: Field Medics
text: At the start of your turn heal each of your champions by 10HP

name: Enchanted Forest
text: At the start of your turn gain 1 mana for each of your champions.

name: Battlements
text: If your fortress is attacked prevent 20 damage and do 20 damage to the attacking Champion.

name: Siege Works
text: At the start of your turn do 10 damage to the enemy fortress for each of your active champions

name: Mist of Grief
text: For every champion you lose to an attack gain 1 mana
